item.text: I’m switching to the political-freedom record: elections, courts, opposition treatment, press freedom, digital controls, and institutional capture. The job here is to separate the inherited weak baseline from anything clearly attributable to Hasina’s 2022 choices, then keep only sources that add distinct evidence rather than restating the same repression pattern.
